card.text: Young F0 star 41 parsecs away in Pegasus, orbited by four giant planets that were photographed directly.

sources.label: Marois et al. 2008
sources.quote: High-contrast observations with the Keck and Gemini telescopes have revealed three planets orbiting the star HR 8799

introduction.text: HR 8799 is a young F0 star 41 parsecs away. It was the first star seen with several planets in direct images: four giants, 16 to 71 au out.

sources.label: Marois et al. 2008
sources.quote: High-contrast observations with the Keck and Gemini telescopes have revealed three planets orbiting the star HR 8799

sources.label: Marois et al. 2010
sources.quote: Here we report the presence of a fourth planet, interior to and about the same mass as the other three.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
